s.how: Rinse 200g jasmine rice and put in a big pot with 2L chicken stock and a 5cm piece of sliced ginger. Bring to the boil, then simmer gently, stirring often, for 1 hour until thick and creamy. Poach 2 chicken breasts in the congee for the last 20 minutes, then shred. Ladle into bowls and top with the chicken, sliced spring onion, soy, a few drops of sesame oil and fried shallots.

s.note: the fight on the runaway bus in San Francisco
s.how: Marinate 800g pork scotch fillet in 4 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy and 2 crushed garlic cloves for 2 hours. Roast at 200C for 35 minutes, basting with the marinade twice, until sticky and charred at the edges. Rest and slice thinly. Steam 12 frozen bao buns for 8 minutes. Fill with pork, thin cucumber sticks, sliced spring onion and crushed peanuts.

m.note: the hidden village of Ta Lo
m.how: Score a 1.2kg whole snapper and steam over sliced ginger and spring onion for 12 minutes. Top with fresh spring onion, pour over 3 tbsp soy, then 4 tbsp smoking hot oil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and bok choy.

w.note: the great protector dragon of Ta Lo
w.how: Blitz 2 mangoes with 60g sugar. Soak 4 gelatine sheets, dissolve in a little warm purée and stir through with 375ml evaporated milk. Set in glasses for 4 hours and top with thin mango slices laid like scales.

d.n: Katy's brown sugar boba milk tea
d.note: Shang-Chi and Katy's laid-back life in San Francisco
d.how: Cook 150g tapioca pearls as the pack says and drain. Simmer 100g dark brown sugar with 60ml water for 3 minutes, add the pearls and cook 2 minutes more until sticky. Brew 3 black tea bags in 300ml boiling water, then chill. Spoon the pearls and syrup into 4 glasses and swirl up the sides. Add ice, then 600ml cold milk mixed with the tea. Serve with fat straws.
